overview.en:
Research keywords, search results, backlinks and competitors using DataForSEO’s official API and documentation tools.

Investigate search visibility with a named site, market, and reporting interval. Compare the provider's available metrics and turn findings into a prioritized optimization brief.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 DataForSEO 官方 API 与文档工具研究关键词、搜索结果、外链和竞争对手。

围绕指定网站、市场和统计周期研究搜索可见性，比较服务商提供的指标，将发现整理成有优先级的优化建议。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Compare our site's search visibility with these competitors in the same market.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 在同一市场比较我们网站与这些竞争对手的搜索可见性。

starterPrompts.en: Research this keyword topic and organize opportunities into a content brief.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 研究这个关键词主题，将机会整理成内容简报。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available site metrics and prioritize the next SEO actions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查可用网站指标，为下一步 SEO 工作排序。

descriptions.en: Use DataForSEO in Ghast. Research keywords, search results, backlinks and competitors using DataForSEO’s official API and documentation tools. 通过 DataForSEO 官方 API 与文档工具研究关键词、搜索结果、外链和竞争对手。
